title: How to Teach Yourself Anything (My System for Making $25M/Month)

idea.name: Direct-to-consumer air filter manufacturer (FilterBuy)
idea.one_liner: Buy a small family air filter manufacturer with an SBA-style loan and grow it into a DTC ecommerce brand competing on fast delivery and fair price
idea.customer: homeowners and businesses replacing HVAC air filters

key_quotes.quote: I took out a million and a half dollar loan to run a business [music] that by every reasonable measure, I had no qualifications to run.
One of the things I worked out in the first year or two was that we weren't really in the air filter business at all.
What the the actually wanted was the right filter deliver fast at a fair price.

claims.quote: my air filter manufacturer making $25 million a month and almost everything that got me here is stuff I had to teach myself from scratch.

claims.claim: Paid an industry consultant ~$1,000/week early on
claims.quote: I was paying him about a thousand dollars a week and at the time, that felt like a lot of money to me.

claims.claim: Shipping millions of packages a year
claims.quote: I had to get a handle on logistics because we were suddenly shipping millions of packages a year.

ideas.delivery: Own manufacturing plus logistics focus on delivery speed; veteran industry consultant for supplier access

idea.name: In-house trucking fleet for a manufacturer (failed)
idea.one_liner: Bought 40+ tractor trailers to cut freight costs and create a profit centre, but shut it down at a loss as trucking proved its own complex business

key_quotes.quote: So, we went, or I went, and bought more than 40 tractor trailers and stood up a whole trucking operation.

claims.claim: Trucking operation shut down at a real loss
claims.quote: Eventually, we shut down the whole thing and took a real loss on it.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Goods vehicle operator licence (O-licence), drivers' hours and tachograph rules
